question: A rectangular coil of $50$ turns and area $4.0 \times 10^{-4}\text{ m}^2$ carries a current of $0.20\text{ A}$. The earth’s magnetic field at a place is $4.0 \times 10^{-5}\text{ T}$ and the angle of dip is $30^\circ$. If the magnetic moment of the coil is perpendicular to the horizontal component of earth’s magnetic field, calculate the horizontal component of earth’s magnetic field, magnetic moment of the coil and torque on the coil.
